meta.title: Supplier without a Tax ID is added with company name, address and city

args.goal: On the open Add Supplier form with Full Name, Phone Number and Email Address already filled, click the blue highlighted text under Tax ID, verify Business Location and Tax ID are hidden and Company Name, Company Address and City are shown, enter a company name and address, select a city from the searchable dropdown, click Done, and stop on the Suppliers List with the new supplier listed.

steps.note: Performs and observes the complete supplier creation flow that has no dedicated catalog step.
Asserts the creation confirmation required after clicking Done.
